timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Welcome to this TLC tutorial. This lesson will discuss the theory of chromatography and
will provide an overview of various chromatographic techniques. The focus of the tutorial will be
on thin layer chromatography or TLC. You can also watch videos which demonstrate how to
prepare, run, and evaluate a TLC analysis.
